definitions.gloss: varied; full of variety; rich in change; diverse
definitions.explanation: Describes something that has abundant variation or diversity. Used for landscapes, climates, experiences, content, and other things characterized by richness and variety.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ{地形|ちけい}を{持|も}つ。
{変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだメニューが{人気|にんき}の{秘密|ひみつ}だ。
examples.english: The varied menu is the secret to its popularity.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{四季|しき}を{通|つう}じて{変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ{景色|けしき}が{楽|たの}しめる。
examples.english: This area offers diverse scenery to enjoy throughout the four seasons.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
The pattern ～に{富|と}む means "to be rich in ~" and is productive: {栄養|えいよう}に{富|と}む (rich in nutrition), {経験|けいけん}に{富|と}む (rich in experience). Most commonly appears in the attributive form ～に{富|と}んだ modifying a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ{景色|けしき} (varied scenery)
- {変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ{内容|ないよう} (varied content)
- {変化|へんか}に{富|と}んだ{人生|じんせい} (a life full of changes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- バラエティに{富|と}む: rich in variety — uses the loanword バラエティ
- {多彩|たさい}な: colorful, diverse — a single-word adjective alternative
- {多様|たよう}な: diverse — more formal/academic
